title: Ek Qaidi Bimaar
body:
Ek Qaidi Bimaar x4
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Ek Qaidi Bimaar Musafir Chale Firne Se Kasir
Jitne Mazalim Utna Sabir Ek Qaidi
Bimaar Musafir
Paikare Sabro Raza Karta Hai Shukre Khuda
Hoton Pe Hamde Khuda
Karta Hai Shukre Khuda
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Raah Me Kaate Pao Me Chaale Chub Jaaye To Kaun Nikaale
Phir Bhi Nahi Hai Gila
Karta Hai Shukre Khuda
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Saath haram Be Makhnao Chadar
Aur Har su badkaar sitamgar
Dete Rahe Taana
Karta Hai Shukre Khuda
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Bhai Baradar Koi Nahi Hai
Moniso Yawar Koi Nahi Hai
Mardo Me Hai Tanha
Karta Hai Shukre Khuda
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Ek Ek Bibi Be Chadar Hai
Bazaro Se Aaj Guzar Hai
Kaisa Makaam Aaya
Karta Hai Shukre Khuda
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Zakhmi Tan Khun Aluda Sir
Kuch Aise Barse Hai Pathar
Phir Bhi Kiya Sajda
Karta Hai Shukre Khuda
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Bekas Beghar Aur Be Saaman
Haye Darindo Me Kuch Insaan
Koi Nahi Apna
Karta Hai Shukre Khuda
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Jitne Masaib Utne Sajde
Kaisa Faseel Ek Insaan Samjhe
Kya Hai Tera Rutba
Karta Hai Shukre Khuda
